reviewMethod: Original AI authoring followed by an author editorial and bilingual equivalence pass. Arabic wording clarified against the unchanged English questions and answer meanings on 2026-10-07. This records AI editing and self-review, not human linguistic approval.

authorship.approach: New playful situations authored for these games; no question lists copied or closely paraphrased from the user reference sites.
authorship.mostLikelyTone: Friendly exaggeration, imaginative outings, performances and group adventures. No boring productivity or achievement prompts.
authorship.knowMeAnswers: All four options are subjective personal choices. The quiz creator supplies their answer; the content defines no globally correct option.

editorialChecks: Arabic meaning matches English without literal word-for-word phrasing
Packs have distinct themes and short understandable choices
Family and teen-friendly prompts with no explicit intimacy, cruelty, criminal accusations or private disclosures
Fictional magic, aliens, costumes and superpowers are presented as playful hypothetical situations
Know Me choices are plausible preferences with no morally preferred correct answer
limitations: This records an author self-review, not an independent linguistic review or user playtesting. Excitement and personal fit are subjective; players should be able to skip a prompt.
